review_candidates.title: SOC Analyst Team Leader
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Description We are seeking a dedicated and experienced SOC Analyst Team Leader with a minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity operations to join our dynamic team. You will be responsible for overseeing threat detection, incident management, and continuous improvement of our SOC capabilities. Responsibilities Lead and supervise a team of SOC analysts to ensure effective monitoring and response to security events. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the latest cybersecurity threats
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Description We are seeking a dedicated and experienced SOC Analyst Team Leader with a minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity operations to join our dynamic team. Provide training and mentorship to SOC team members to build technical expertise. Requirements Minimum of 2 years of experience in a SOC analyst role with leadership responsibilities.
